context:
Use docs/reference/backward-compatibility.md as the single source of truth and process
removals module-by-module in deterministic waves: core/platform/cli first, then tests,
then docs. Prefer deleting code paths over redirecting aliases. When a legacy path and
canonical path share logic, extract canonical behavior first, then remove branching.
description:
Remove all backward-compatibility elements currently tracked in
docs/reference/backward-compatibility.md to align with alpha-stage product policy.

Baseline inventory at kickoff tracked 89 compatibility markers
(67 active, 22 deprecate).
This item executes immediate removal of the entire compatibility surface, including:
- alias/re-export compatibility shims
- legacy argument and field fallbacks
- legacy mode and path synonyms
- old result-shape adaptation logic where still retained
- compatibility-only CLI branches and helper wrappers

This work intentionally allows API and behavior changes in favor of a smaller,
cleaner, canonical pre-1.0 interface. Documentation and tests must be updated
in the same implementation window so CI remains green on the canonical paths.

anti_patterns.dont: batch unverified removals across unrelated subsystems

anti_patterns.why: this prolongs surface-area and maintenance cost

anti_patterns.dont: update only docs or only tests without deleting code branches
anti_patterns.instead: delete implementation first then align tests/docs.
anti_patterns.why: stale compatibility paths will remain executable

preserves.behavior: Canonical benchmark execution paths (`benchbox run` with supported platforms/benchmarks) remain functional.
Core result generation and export for the canonical schema continue to work end-to-end.
Non-compatibility feature behavior (query execution correctness and validation semantics) is not changed beyond compatibility removal.

verifications.description: Backward-compatibility registry no longer contains active benchbox compatibility rows
verifications.expected: No output, or the registry page has been replaced by a historical note without active benchbox compatibility rows

verifications.command: rg -n "backward compatibility|Backward compatibility|legacy compatibility|for backward compatibility|backward-compatible|LegacyGetTablesSource|compatibility alias" benchbox
verifications.description: No compatibility-shim markers remain in production code

verifications.expected: Type checking passes with no errors
Fast tests pass at project CI gate
